Granny Shu looks at your hands rather than your face. ‘You sort faster than the last one. Come in the mornings.’ A cracked jade slip turns over in her fingers. ‘Nobody will have this. Six coin, if you are foolish.’

The pooled breath turns, and returns, and turns again without being asked. Foundation. The method has room to grow in it now, and so does the road: the ferry crossing, and the outskirts of Old Ridge beyond it.
A traveller at the ferry asks after whoever cleared the fall. Headman Lu points at you without looking up.
Walk the ridge outskirts is now known.
